bookSourceComment: 公有领域古籍。搜索按标题匹配；正文为简体（/zh-hans/ 变体）。无段评。

ruleSearch.name: $.title

ruleToc.chapterList:
<js>
var u = String(baseUrl);
try { u = decodeURIComponent(u); } catch (e) {}
var s = u.indexOf('/zh-hans/') + 9, q = u.indexOf('?', s);
var name = u.substring(s, q < 0 ? u.length : q).replace(/ /g, '_');
var els = java.getElements('@CSS:.mw-parser-output a[href]');
var out = [], seen = {};
for (var i = 0; i < els.size(); i++) {
  var a = els.get(i), h = String(a.attr('href'));
  try { h = decodeURIComponent(h); } catch (e) {}
  h = h.split('#')[0];
  if (h.indexOf('/wiki/' + name + '/') >= 0 && !seen[h]) { seen[h] = 1; out.push(a); }
}
if (out.length == 0) out.push(java.getElement('@CSS:#headerContainer b'));
out
</js>
